verification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';import{createHash}from'node:crypto';import{rootInitialSelectorCanApply}from'./tests/material-parity/root-initial-style-evidence.mjs'; const normalize=k=>k.replaceAll('-','').toLowerCase(); const affects=k=>props.map(normalize).includes(normalize(k))||['font','all','whitespacecollapse','textwrap','textwrapmode','textwrapstyle','wordwrap'].includes(normalize(k))||/^(animation|transition)/i.test(k); const digest=b=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex'), combos=new Map(), cases=[]; for(const[kind,entries]of[['static',raw.results],['interaction',raw.interactions]])for(const e of entries){  const c=kind+':'+e.family+'@'+e.profile+'/'+e.viewport.id+(e.state?'/'+e.state:'');  const t={};for(const side of['reference','astylar']){const src=e.inputTrees[side],bytes=readFileSync(src.file);assert.equal(digest(bytes),src.sha256);t[side]=JSON.parse(bytes);}  const ref=t.reference,ast=t.astylar,rs=ref.nodes.find(n=>n.attributes?.id===e.family+'-root'),as=ast.nodes.find(n=>n.authored?.id===e.family+'-root');  assert.ok(rs&&as,c);const rf=ref.nodes.find(n=>n.key===rs.parent),ap=ast.nodes.find(n=>n.key===as.parent);assert.ok(rf&&ap,c);  const observation={reference:[rf,rs].map(n=>({type:n.type,ownText:n.ownText,values:Object.fromEntries(props.map(p=>[p,ref.styles[n.style][p]])),requests:n.rules.flatMap(i=>{const r=ref.rules[i];return Object.entries(r.declarations).filter(([k])=>affects(k)).map(([k,v])=>({selector:r.selector,property:k,value:v,active:r.active}));}),inline:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(n.inline??{}).filter(([k])=>affects(k)))})),  candidate:[ap,as].map(n=>({type:n.authored.type,ownText:n.authored.textContent??'',values:Object.fromEntries(['normalResolvedStyle','resolvedStyle','interactionResolvedStyle'].map(s=>[s,Object.fromEntries(props.map(p=>[p,n[s]?.[p]??'<omitted>']))])),requests:ast.rules.filter(r=>rootInitialSelectorCanApply(r.selector,n.authored)).flatMap(r=>Object.entries(r).filter(([k])=>affects(k)).map(([k,v])=>({selector:r.selector,property:k,value:v}))),inline:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(n.authored.style??{}).filter(([k])=>affects(k)))}))};  const sig=JSON.stringify(observation);if(!combos.has(sig))combos.set(sig,{observation,cases:[]});combos.get(sig).cases.push(c);cases.push(c); } console.log(JSON.stringify({cases:cases.length,uniqueCases:new Set(cases).size,combinations:[...combos.values()].map(g=>({observation:g.observation,occurrences:g.cases.length,caseListSha256:digest(JSON.stringify(g.cases.sort())),sample:g.cases.slice(0,3)}))}));"
